sources.scope: Official prospectus: degree identity, language, research questions and major descriptions.
Official 2026–27 OCASYS programme: Molecular Life Sciences course codes and block sequence.
Adopted 2026–27 Biology regulations Appendices II, III, IV (4.1.3, 4.2 and 4.4).

curriculum: The English-medium Biology BSc has four majors for new entrants. Integrative Biology is available only through cohort 2024 under Appendix II. The generic comparison illustrates Molecular Life Sciences, first in the official catalog. The first semester is shared across majors. Molecular Life Sciences then takes the common life sciences second-semester sequence listed in Appendix III, rather than the Ecology and Evolution sequence. The 180 EC allocation is 60 EC of first-year study, 90 EC of major courses in years two and three and 30 EC of minor study. The year-two 60 EC includes one choice from Integrative Neuroscience and Medical Structural Biology, here Medical Structural Biology. The last semester comprises Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques as the required option-group selection, Biology of Cancer and Epigenetics and Gene-editing as permitted 5 EC electives, and the 15 EC supervised project. The catalog places the three 5 EC courses in blocks 2a.1, 2a.2 and 2a.3 respectively before the 2b project. The 30 EC minor remains open subject to eligibility. The Neuroscience university minor is excluded for Biology students. For applicable life sciences minors the congress forms part of the 30 EC, not an extra degree requirement.
progression: Article 4.4.1 requires Laboratory and Theoretical Research Skills to be taken together, with distinct 5 EC codes. Articles 4.4.6 and 4.4.6.1 require 90 earned EC outside the minor, including all first-year components, and participation in Practical Carrousel before the major project. The project is specific to the selected major. Appendix IV lists no separate hard prerequisites for the three selected electives, and the prior sequence includes molecular genetics, cell biology, immunology and laboratory skills. The current course catalog marks listings draft; the formal regulations govern credit, option and entry rules, and the catalog provides consistent block placement.
